feature_descriptions.rainfall_mm: Current 24-hour observed rainfall in millimeters (or 1-hour for telemetry)
feature_descriptions.api_7day: Antecedent Precipitation Index computed with decay lambda=0.85 over 7 days
feature_descriptions.rainfall_trend_ratio: Ratio of current day rainfall to 3-day cumulative rainfall
feature_descriptions.is_monsoon: Boolean flag (1 for June-Sept monsoon months, 0 otherwise)

target_description: Binary flag (1 = waterlogged event verified, 0 = verified non-waterlogged control observation)
